cues: The central ion accepts electron pairs, a Lewis acid.
The ligand donates them, a Lewis base.
The number of dative bonds is the coordination number, here four.
The bracketed part is the coordination sphere, and the sulphate outside is the counter ion.
text: The vocabulary. The central ion accepts electron pairs, a Lewis acid. The ligand donates them, a Lewis base. The number of dative bonds is the coordination number, here four. The bracketed part is the coordination sphere, and the sulphate outside is the counter ion.
